text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Humph! Who called for me just now?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
............ Strange. I definitely heard a 
voice...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The statue of the Three Goddesses...? No, 
there's no way it could talk.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it bothered them. They just 
couldn't get it out of their head.
